id: \bTo clear the trial you have to battle against five Trainers in a row. This is going to be hard.
en: \bTo clear the trial you have to battle against five Trainers in a row. This is going to be hard.
it: \bPer superare la prova devi lottare contro cinque Allenatori di fila. Sarà dura.

id: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.
en: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rThe trial was easy. It's Anabel that's tough.
en: \rThe trial was easy. It's Anabel that's tough.
it: \rLa prova era facile. È Anabel quella tosta.

id: \bI came here to support my friend. I hope she is winning.
en: \bI came here to support my friend. I hope she is winning.
it: \bSono venuto a fare il tifo per la mia amica. Spero stia vincendo.

id: \rThrough here you battle for the right to challenge Anabel. Are you ready?
en: \rThrough here you battle for the right to challenge Anabel. Are you ready?
it: \rDa qui si lotta per il diritto di sfidare Anabel. Sei pronto?

id: \rYou need to clear the trial before you can fight Anabel.
en: \rYou need to clear the trial before you can fight Anabel.
it: \rDevi superare la prova prima di poter affrontare Anabel.

id: \rThrough here you battle Anabel. Are you ready?
en: \rThrough here you battle Anabel. Are you ready?
it: \rDa qui si va a lottare contro Anabel. Sei pronto?

id: \bYou're going to need more than luck to win. Want me to teach you Torment?
en: \bYou're going to need more than luck to win. Want me to teach you Torment?
it: \bTi servirà più della fortuna per vincere. Vuoi che ti insegni Attaccalite?

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?
